correctness.rationale: The graph Laplacian has orthogonal projectors J/N, I-E, and E-J/N with eigenvalues 0, (r-1)m, rm. Direct rational functional calculus gives strictly positive off-diagonal orbit entries and a diagonal whose sign is C_{r,m}(mh), with exact polynomial identity independently checked. All unconditional cases have positive-polynomial certificates and remaining cases have explicit negative witnesses. The cubic coefficient of C is negative and other sign pattern yields exactly two variations for r>=3,m>=2; the witnesses and endpoint signs force exactly two distinct positive roots, giving one bounded unsafe interval. Seven exact rational direct inversions agree with all orbit formulas. Independent validation not performed.

value.rationale: A natural physical/numerical criterion—nonnegative one-step probabilities for stable implicit diffusion—is completely classified on a two-parameter infinite graph family. The exact boundary of unconditional safety and exactly two algebraic positivity-reentry thresholds in every failing case are actionable for timestep choices. This is not merely a single example or polynomial computation: it proves a universal all-real-time phase diagram including proof of the absence of other negative entry types or missed intervals.
